results.question: How many phone campaigns are available for sale, by device?

runs.sql:
-- Answers: How many phone campaigns are available for sale, by device
SELECT t.device_commercial_name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.offer_id) AS campaign_count FROM VID.D_DEVICE_OFFERING t WHERE t.product_sub_type_cd = 'PHONE' AND t.offer_edt >= SYSDATE AND t.brightstar_end_dt = TO_DATE('4712-12-31 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') GROUP BY t.device_commercial_name ORDER BY campaign_count DESC

-- Answers: How many phone campaigns are available for sale, by device
SELECT t1.device_commercial_name, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.offer_id) AS campaign_count FROM VID.D_DEVICE_OFFERING t1 WHERE t1.product_sub_type_cd = 'PHONE' AND t1.offer_edt >= SYSDATE AND t1.brightstar_end_dt = TO_DATE('4712-12-31 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') GROUP BY t1.device_commercial_name ORDER BY campaign_count DESC

-- Answers: How many phone campaigns are available for sale, by device
SELECT t1.device_commercial_name, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.offer_id) AS phone_campaign_count FROM VID.D_DEVICE_OFFERING t1 WHERE t1.product_sub_type_cd = 'PHONE' AND t1.offer_edt >= SYSDATE AND t1.brightstar_end_dt = TO_DATE('4712-12-31 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') GROUP BY t1.device_commercial_name ORDER BY phone_campaign_count DESC

results.question: Which customer segment had the highest number of unique customers assigned in June 2025?

runs.sql:
-- Answers: Customer segment with the highest number of unique customers assigned in June 2025
SELECT t1.segment, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.unified_customer_id) AS unique_customers_count FROM VID.D_CONV_SEGMENT_HIST t1 WHERE t1.segment_sdt < DATE '2025-07-01' AND t1.segment_edt >= DATE '2025-06-01' GROUP BY t1.segment ORDER BY unique_customers_count DESC

-- Answers: Customer segment with the highest number of unique customers assigned in June 2025
SELECT t.segment, COUNT(DISTINCT t.unified_customer_id) AS unique_customers
FROM VID.D_CONV_SEGMENT_HIST t
WHERE t.segment_sdt < DATE '2025-07-01' AND t.segment_edt >= DATE '2025-06-01'
GROUP BY t.segment
ORDER BY unique_customers DESC

-- Answers: Customer segment with the highest number of unique customers assigned in June 2025
SELECT t.segment, COUNT(DISTINCT t.unified_customer_id) AS unique_customers
FROM VID.D_CONV_SEGMENT_HIST t
WHERE t.segment_sdt < DATE '2025-07-01'
  AND t.segment_edt >= DATE '2025-06-01'
GROUP BY t.segment
ORDER BY unique_customers DESC

results.question: Compare monthly gross adds and disconnections for July and August 2026, showing the month-over-month change in each.

runs.sql: WITH monthly_kpis AS (SELECT TRUNC(t.from_main_offer_sdt, 'MM') AS month_start, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.lifecycle_group_cd = 'grossadd' THEN t.subscription_id END) AS gross_adds, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.lifecycle_group_cd = 'disconnection' THEN t.subscription_id END) AS disconnections FROM VID.F_LIFECYCLE_KPI t WHERE t.from_main_offer_sdt >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND t.from_main_offer_sdt < DATE '2026-09-01' AND t.lifecycle_group_cd IN ('grossadd', 'disconnection') GROUP BY TRUNC(t.from_main_offer_sdt, 'MM')) SELECT m.month_start, m.gross_adds, m.disconnections, m.gross_adds - LAG(m.gross_adds, 1) OVER (ORDER BY m.month_start) AS mom_gross_adds_change, m.disconnections - LAG(m.disconnections, 1) OVER (ORDER BY m.month_start) AS mom_disconnections_change FROM monthly_kpis m ORDER BY m.month_start

WITH monthly_stats AS (SELECT TRUNC(t.event_dt, 'MM') AS month_start, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.lifecycle_group_cd = 'grossadd' THEN t.subscription_id END) AS gross_adds, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.lifecycle_group_cd = 'disconnection' THEN t.subscription_id END) AS disconnections FROM VID.F_LIFECYCLE_KPI t WHERE t.event_dt >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND t.event_dt < DATE '2026-09-01' AND t.lifecycle_group_cd IN ('grossadd', 'disconnection') GROUP BY TRUNC(t.event_dt, 'MM')) SELECT TO_CHAR(m.month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS calendar_month, m.gross_adds, m.gross_adds - LAG(m.gross_adds) OVER (ORDER BY m.month_start) AS mom_gross_adds_change, m.disconnections, m.disconnections - LAG(m.disconnections) OVER (ORDER BY m.month_start) AS mom_disconnections_change FROM monthly_stats m ORDER BY m.month_start

WITH monthly_kpi AS (SELECT TRUNC(t.event_dt, 'MM') AS month_start, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.lifecycle_group_cd = 'grossadd' THEN t.subscription_id END) AS gross_adds, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.lifecycle_group_cd = 'disconnection' THEN t.subscription_id END) AS disconnections FROM VID.F_LIFECYCLE_KPI t WHERE t.event_dt >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND t.event_dt < DATE '2026-09-01' AND t.lifecycle_group_cd IN ('grossadd', 'disconnection') GROUP BY TRUNC(t.event_dt, 'MM')) SELECT TO_CHAR(month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS calendar_month, gross_adds, gross_adds - LAG(gross_adds, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS mom_gross_adds_change, disconnections, disconnections - LAG(disconnections, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS mom_disconnections_change FROM monthly_kpi ORDER BY month_start

results.question: As of 28 August 2026, how many subscribers in the mobile base used a physical SIM and how many used an eSIM?

runs.sql:
-- Answers: Breakdown of subscribers by physical SIM vs eSIM as of 28 August 2026
SELECT t2.esim_ind, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.subscription_id) AS subscriber_count FROM VID.F_SUBSCRIPTION_D t1 JOIN VID.D_ICCI_IMSI_SUBS_HIST t2 ON t1.subscription_id = t2.subscription_id WHERE t1.snapshot_dt = DATE '2026-08-28' AND t2.icci_imsi_subs_sdt <= DATE '2026-08-28' AND t2.icci_imsi_subs_edt > DATE '2026-08-28' GROUP BY t2.esim_ind

-- Answers: Breakdown of subscribers using a physical SIM vs eSIM as of 28 August 2026
SELECT t2.esim_ind, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.subscription_id) AS subscriber_count FROM VID.F_SUBSCRIPTION_D t1 JOIN VID.D_ICCI_IMSI_SUBS_HIST t2 ON t1.subscription_id = t2.subscription_id WHERE t1.snapshot_dt = DATE '2026-08-28' AND t2.icci_imsi_subs_sdt <= DATE '2026-08-28' AND t2.icci_imsi_subs_edt > DATE '2026-08-28' GROUP BY t2.esim_ind

-- Answers: Breakdown of subscribers by physical SIM vs eSIM as of 28 August 2026
SELECT t1.esim_ind, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.subscription_id) AS subscriber_count FROM VID.D_ICCI_IMSI_SUBS_HIST t1 JOIN VID.F_SUBSCRIPTION_D t2 ON t1.subscription_id = t2.subscription_id WHERE t2.snapshot_dt = DATE '2026-08-28' AND t1.icci_imsi_subs_sdt <= DATE '2026-08-28' AND t1.icci_imsi_subs_edt > DATE '2026-08-28' GROUP BY t1.esim_ind

results.question: For every disconnection in August 2026, which tariff was the subscription on at the moment of the event? Count disconnections per tariff.

runs.sql: SELECT t.offer_id, t.offer_num, COUNT(DISTINCT l.subscription_id) AS disconnection_count FROM VID.F_LIFECYCLE_KPI l JOIN VID.D_SUBS_TARIFF_HIST h ON l.subscription_id = h.subscription_id JOIN VID.D_TARIFF t ON h.offer_id = t.offer_id WHERE l.lifecycle_group_cd = 'disconnection' AND l.event_dt >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND l.event_dt < DATE '2026-09-01' AND l.event_dt BETWEEN h.subs_offer_sdt AND h.subs_offer_edt GROUP BY t.offer_id, t.offer_num ORDER BY disconnection_count DESC

SELECT t.offer_id, t.offer_num, COUNT(DISTINCT l.subscription_id) AS disconnection_count FROM VID.F_LIFECYCLE_KPI l JOIN VID.D_SUBS_TARIFF_HIST h ON l.subscription_id = h.subscription_id JOIN VID.D_TARIFF t ON h.offer_id = t.offer_id WHERE l.lifecycle_group_cd = 'disconnection' AND l.month_id = '202608' AND l.from_main_offer_sdt >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND l.from_main_offer_sdt < DATE '2026-09-01' AND l.from_main_offer_sdt BETWEEN h.subs_offer_sdt AND h.subs_offer_edt GROUP BY t.offer_id, t.offer_num ORDER BY disconnection_count DESC
